parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the service is deployed.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: A keyword for the search. You can search by instance name, instance IP address, host IP address, or instance type.

parameters.name: HostIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the host where the service instance is deployed.

parameters.name: InstanceIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the service instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the service instance.

parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description: The status of the service instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type.

parameters.name: IsSpot
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance is a spot instance.

parameters.name: ListReplica
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query the list of instance replicas.

parameters.name: MemberType
parameters.description: The type of the sub-service. This parameter is valid only for aggregation services.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 100.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description: The quota ID.

parameters.name: ReplicaName
parameters.description: The name of the instance replica.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource group to which the service instance belongs.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: The role of the service.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The service name. For more information, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The field to use for sorting.
